ci.toml.purpose: verify inactive Jeryu jobs stay forge-neutral and route to local lane scripts

crates/harness-core/.purpose: prove adapter trait, capability matrix, and simulator conformance

crates/harness-claude/.purpose: prove Claude adapter parsing and argv guardrails

crates/runner/tests/kill_retry.rs.purpose: prove the connected successor-fence identity with an explicitly admitted digest-bound Gitd subject

crates/runner/tests/loop_sim.rs.purpose: prove the connected production-authority refusal identity with an explicitly admitted digest-bound Gitd subject

crates/behavior/.purpose: prove the §17 planned catalog and non-authoritative detector scaffolds
